old_caption: The video captures a static aerial view of a mountainous landscape, showcasing the majestic peaks and lush green slopes. The scene focuses on a steep, verdant hillside, dotted with patches of snow clinging to its rocky outcrops. The rugged contours of the mountains are visible, their jagged edges softened by the misty clouds that partially obscure the peaks, adding a sense of mystery and depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is serene and awe-inspiring, inviting viewers to appreciate the raw beauty of nature.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a breathtaking aerial view of a mountainous landscape, showcasing the majestic peaks and lush green slopes. The camera begins by focusing on a steep, verdant hillside, dotted with patches of snow clinging to its rocky outcrops. As the camera pans upward, it reveals the rugged contours of the mountains, their jagged edges softened by the misty clouds that drift lazily across the sky. The clouds, thick and white, partially obscure the peaks, adding a sense of mystery and depth to the scene. The camera continues to move, providing a dynamic perspective of the mountain's grandeur, highlighting the interplay between the natural elements of earth, air, and water. The overall atmosphere is serene and awe-inspiring, inviting viewers to appreciate the raw beauty of nature.
caption: The video captures an aerial view of a steep alpine ridge, where dark green grassy slopes carry scattered snow patches along the upper ridgelines and a deep saddle cuts diagonally through the center. A thick bank of white fog fills the right side of the frame, while within the central gully a bright plume of cloud continuously morphs and drifts. Its dense tongue shifts shape at the saddle mouth throughout the clip. The fog wrapping the rounded foreground shoulder slowly redistributes, gradually exposing a small patch of vegetation on its right slope. The camera drifts gently, nudging the whole scene downward and rightward so that an isolated snow fleck near the bottom edge slides partly out of view. The terrain itself holds static while the cloud and viewpoint keep moving, the ridge remaining partly veiled by the drifting vapor.
